run_interactive_translation: run the fairseq interactive CLI to translate raw text with a trained model
run_buffered_read: run buffered_read to read input lines in batches of a given buffer size
run_make_batches: run make_batches to tokenize input lines and yield Batch namedtuples for inference
run_main: run the main function to load a model ensemble and perform interactive translation
run_cli_main: run cli_main to parse arguments and start the interactive translation pipeline
